# SG candidate synthetic source fixtures

These files are synthetic development fixtures. They contain no live API
acceptance, real credentials, owner approval or production database contents.
The tiny white image and scripted Category/weapon-shape answers test contracts
and UI flow only; they do not demonstrate prediction quality.

Follow `docs/SG_LOCAL_REVIEW_GUIDE.md`. Source fixtures stay here; browser
operation copies belong under `Documents/ShopeeE2E` per repository rules.

CSV line endings are fixed to LF by `.gitattributes`: the text and image
sidecars bind the exact candidate CSV bytes. Keep this binding intact.
